AIDS Awareness Disc, The.name: AIDS Awareness
AIDS Awareness Disc, The.summary: AIDS Awareness contains 100 questions to test your awareness of the facts about HIV and AIDS. You won't know all of the answers-- in fact, many of the questions are very difficult. As you select your answers, the program will tell you whether you are right or wrong, and it will tell you why. By the time you've answered all of the questions, you will be AIDS Aware.

Dark Castle.name: Dark Castle
Dark Castle.summary: The Phillips CD-i port features colored graphics and cd quality music of the intro which loops infinitely during gameplay.

Sandy's Circus Adventure.name: Sandy's Circus Adventure
Sandy's Circus Adventure.summary: Sandy, the cuddly sea lion, is lost in the circus and your child is invited along! Together they can explore all the excitement, fun and adventure of the Big Top. They can romp with the clowns, get shot out of a cannon, disappear in a magician’s hat, play with jugglers and much, much more.
